source.note: Custom table: the lab defines it, so its Terraform is the reference. harness.py check compares these names with telemetry.tf.

shims.name: _GetWatchlist
shims.purpose: One store table per alias a rule calls (schemas.json "watchlists"); the union carries every alias's columns, so a rule projecting the columns of its own watchlist resolves them. All values are strings, as in Sentinel.

shims.name: _GetWatchlist
shims.purpose: A watchlist with no items. Sentinel builds the top-level columns from the items (bag_unpack), so with none there are no watchlist columns at all - only the base ones. A rule that projects ExpiresOn / Name from it then depends on union isfuzzy=true tolerating the unresolved leg. verify: the exact base columns against a Sentinel workspace.

shims.name: _GetWatchlist
shims.purpose: No _GetWatchlist at all (a Log Analytics workspace without Sentinel): the rule's union isfuzzy=true leg must be dropped, not fail the query.

probes.question: Is a record whose array is EMPTY kept by mv-apply when the subquery is a summarize with no by? (Learn, mv-expand: an empty array produces no record; mv-apply expands with mv-expand first.)
probes.query: datatable(k:string, a:dynamic)['empty', dynamic([]), 'one', dynamic(['x'])] | mv-apply e = a on (summarize n = count(), s = make_set(tostring(e)))

probes.question: Same, for a null dynamic (Learn, mv-expand: a null produces a single null record).

reliedOnBy: app-credential-added / ca-policy-changed: a modified property whose oldValue is null

probes.question: After a leftouter join with no match, is a right-side string column null or empty, and a datetime null?
